interface.signature: def captainAmerica(N: int, M: int, V: list[list[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of rooms N is between 1 and 30000 inclusive.
The number of gates M is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.
The list V contains exactly M edges.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(u, int) and isinstance(v, int) and 1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in V)
preconditions.description: Each edge in V is a pair of integers representing valid room indices between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len([r for r in range(1, N + 1) if all(any(all((u, v) in V for v in adj_list[r]) for u in range(1, N + 1)) for adj_list in [build_adj(V, N)])])
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of rooms r such that every other room in the graph can reach r via a directed path.
